home.headline: Hi, I'm {name}.
home.intro: I study Computer Science at the University of Central Florida, where I'm also a Teaching Assistant for core CS courses. I'm the sole developer of cursedconcepts.xyz, a community platform with active users, and I build AI tools with agentic workflows and RAG.

about.heading: About me
paragraphs: I'm a Computer Science student at UCF with a 3.9 GPA, working across software engineering, backend and full-stack development, and AI/ML.

As a Teaching Assistant I support 140 students in Computer Science II, and I previously supported 220 students in Object-Oriented Programming. I help with Java debugging, code review and office hours, and I grade assignments and exams on data structures, algorithms and Big-O analysis.

Outside class I design, build and ship my own products. Cursed Concepts is a full-stack community platform I built and launched on my own, and my AI Job Match app uses an agentic workflow to rank job listings against a resume.

projects.title: Cursed Concepts
projects.summary: A full-stack community platform with active users for sharing hero concepts for Valve's Deadlock.
projects.description: I designed, built and launched cursedconcepts.xyz as the sole developer. It has user accounts, profiles, concepts, comments, feeds, notifications and image uploads, with Clerk authentication, UploadThing image handling, Zod validation and webhooks. It also includes protected moderation and admin tooling and automated tests with Vitest.

projects.title: AI Job Match
projects.summary: Discovers job listings and scores each role against an uploaded resume using an agentic AI workflow.
projects.description: An agentic workflow analyzes each job's requirements alongside the candidate's qualifications, then matches and ranks the roles automatically. Resume and job-description details are structured into comparable criteria, so every listing shows the candidate's strengths, gaps and how relevant the role is.

projects.title: SQL Server Database Health Check
projects.summary: A .NET MVC web app that scans SQL Server instances and reports on database health.
projects.description: Built with .NET MVC and Entity Framework. Automated queries scan the server and return the essential server and database information needed to assess its health.
projects.imageAlt: Screenshot of the SQL Server Database Health Check app

projects.title: SASE Hackathon: Student Rental Search
projects.summary: A rental-search app for students relocating for school, built by a four-person team during a hackathon.
projects.description: I developed the backend API with Python Flask and PostgreSQL for storing and retrieving the app's data, helping the team deliver a working MVP before the hackathon deadline.
projects.imageAlt: Screenshot of the student rental-search app

projects.title: Local Chatbot Agent
projects.summary: A conversational AI that runs fully locally with Ollama and Llama 3.2, using RAG for grounded answers.
projects.description: A LangChain vector database and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) workflow supplies relevant context and references to the model before it generates each response.
projects.imageAlt: Screenshot of the local chatbot agent
